tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with README.md to understand the project's design objectives, message queue setups, and local dev environments.

tour.title: Server Bootstrapping
tour.description: The main server entry points boot up the HTTP connection, configure cross-cutting middlewares, and register route controllers.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript environment setup starting up Express and loading process.env configs clean.

tour.title: Configuration & Database Adapters
tour.description: Initializes Mongoose adapters for MongoDB connection pools and loads configurations.

tour.title: API Routing Gateway
tour.description: Acts as the central API gateway routing public and private requests to specific feature modules.

tour.title: Authentication Services
tour.description: Handles JWT pair generation, token verification, permissions checking, and security keys storage.

tour.title: Product Factory & Inventory
tour.description: Utilizes the Factory pattern to handle custom product types (clothing, electronics) and registers initial warehouse inventory.

tour.title: Discount & Coupon Engine
tour.description: Manages discounts, verifies coupon eligibility, and applies promo codes to cart prices.

tour.title: Shopping Cart Operations
tour.description: Orchestrates user carts, tracking product states, and calculating current totals.

tour.title: Checkout & Order Flow
tour.description: Processes checkouts, reserves product stock, checks discounts, and writes order histories.

tour.title: Event-Driven Message Queues
tour.description: Asynchronous integration tests using Kafka and RabbitMQ to process tasks in background workers.

tour.title: Deployment & Containers
tour.description: Docker and Docker Compose settings defining how all databases, queue workers, and servers run locally.
tour.languageLesson: Multi-stage builds allow building the TS project in a builder node, leaving the minimal runner with no build overhead.
